title: Person: Mrs Dedalus
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Mrs Dedalus

anchor.prefix:
overed the dish boldly and said:

 —Now then, who’s for more turkey?

 Nobody answered. Dante said:

 —Nice language for any catholic to use!

 —Mrs Riordan, I appeal to you, said
anchor.suffix:
, to let the matter drop now.

 Dante turned on her and said:

 —And am I to sit here and listen to the pastors of my church being flouted?

 —Nobody is saying a word against them,
